column1: # Method batch: the session contracts (SessionMode, StartableSessionMode, SaveGameStore) plus the
# Mapping the INTERFACES renames the whole override family, so one row here clarifies every
#  * SessionMode.a()   -> SkirmishGameMode returns store.b(); SaveGameStore.b() is the "exists"
#    query, and SkirmishGameMode.a(World) uses it as the guard before saving.
#    SessionMode.b()   -> store.a(), which is the World-returning method of SaveGameStore = load.
#    SessionMode.a(World) -> guarded store.a(world) = save (returns boolean on the store).
#    SessionMode.c()   -> store.a(otherStore.a()): saves what the START store loads, i.e. it puts
#    the starting world back into the current slot.
#    "SkirmishSuccessETC" / "SkirmishFailureETC" strings, and only the success one increments the
#    win counter, so they are the victory and defeat messages.
#  * StartableSessionMode.b(World) -> SkirmishGameMode increments the games counter, persists it
#    and writes the world into BOTH the current and the start slot: that is the start of a session.
#    StartableSessionMode.d()      -> calls c() (delete) on both stores.
#  * SkirmishGameMode e()/f() -> the two counters read from/written to skirmish.data:
#    d is incremented in b(World) (every start) and e only in the victory path.
#    g()/h() are the private load/save of those counters (g() reads them, h() writes them).
# Descriptors come from javap: do not edit them, the renamer matches on them.
# Columns: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> new
